title: Equivalent trace and row-sum bounds for Vendi Score and LCR
statement:
Let $Z$ be an $n\times n$ positive semidefinite similarity matrix as above, and let $\mathbf{1}$ denote the $n$-dimensional all-ones vector. **Equivalent bounds conjecture.** For $q>1$,

$$
\operatorname{tr}(Z^q)\leq\sum_i\left(\sum_j Z_{ij}\right)^{q-1}=\mathbf{1}^{\mathsf T}(Z\mathbf{1})^{q-1},
$$

while for $q<1$,

$$
\operatorname{tr}(Z^q)\geq\mathbf{1}^{\mathsf T}(Z\mathbf{1})^{q-1}.
$$

These inequalities would imply the Vendi Score–LCR bound for all orders other than $q=1$, potentially with the missing case obtained by continuity. They are presented as an approach to proving the preceding conjecture and are not established in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.03849

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2025).
source_name: Phuc Nguyen, Josiah Couch, Rahul Bansal, Alexandra Morgan, Chris Tam, Miao Li, Rima Arnaout and Ramy Arnaout, “Which Similarity-Sensitive Entropy (Sentropy)?”, arXiv:2511.03849 (2026).
